rules_bounded_execution.allowed: After a source hand contains required cards, output only that source-card access witnessed. Optionally include the matching verified Cycle119 finite precondition result as a separate CONDITIONAL example; never claim the sampled cards were cast or battlefield-ready.
forbidden: inferring win rates from drawn packages
running Cycle119 World with invented mana and calling it actual sourced game execution
assuming Basalt Rings or Ravager transformation is castable simply because draw includes cards
assuming opponent tutor/win-spell exists or responds at scripted window
forcing a rare success when none sampled
casting Jewel on entry with restricted mana or its mana as normal spell mana
